annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on type-approval of motor vehicles and engines and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles, with respect to their emissions and battery durability (Euro 7) and repealing Regulations (EC) No 715/2007 and (EC) No 595/2009
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation on type-approval of motor vehicles and engines with respect to their emissions and battery durability (Euro 7)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission legislative proposal (COM(2022) 586) for the Euro 7 Regulation. It merges the light- and heavy-duty vehicle emission type-approval rules, sets updated exhaust and non-exhaust (brake, tyre) limits, battery durability requirements, on-board monitoring, anti-tampering and cybersecurity measures, and an environmental vehicle passport. It does not deal with AI or autonomous vehicles.
key_provisions_or_claims: Single regulation replacing Euro 6/VI Regulations 715/2007 and 595/2009 for cars, vans, lorries and buses
New emission limits including brake particle and tyre abrasion, with lifetime durability requirements
Mandatory on-board monitoring, OBD, OBFCM and battery state-of-health monitors
Anti-tampering and cybersecurity obligations per UN Regulation 155
Environmental vehicle passport; application from 2025 for light-duty and 2027 for heavy-duty vehicles
